'''Confession Booth II''' is a blueprint that can be build in the [[Church]].

Each booth placed gives +7 {{Icon|Church Quality}}.  A maximum of 2 booths can be placed. It shares the same location as [[Confession Booth I]] and [[Confession Booth III]].
